## Reproduction

Provide the smallest command, input, or sequence that reproduces the problem.

## Expected behavior

What should happen?

## Actual behavior

What happens instead? Include the error output without credentials or private data.

## Impact

Who is affected, and what work is blocked or incorrect?

## Environment

Include the project version, Python version, operating system, and relevant tool versions.

## Regression test

Describe the test that should fail before the fix and pass afterward.
